_what: How the live-words stream steps its quality down on a bad connection and up again, and which endpoint it opens (tools/listen-for-a-while/show/adaptation-ladder.ts). The rungs themselves are the `ladder` of live-audio-stream.json. A reading is bad when more than bad.backlog_bytes wait unsent or the connection was lost; step_down_after_bad bad readings in a row step down one rung, recover_after_good good readings in a row step back up one. `events` are the plain names each change is told with. `failover.endpoints` are tried in order; no address is fixed here, the page that opens the stream gives its own endpoints (createFailover(store, { ...failover, endpoints })); an endpoint that failed is left alone for cooldown_ms, persisted under store_key, and the first one is used again when every endpoint is cooling.
